name: brand-member-invitation-flow
title: Add verified business-owner and Brand member invitation flow
description: Require email verification for new business owners and let Brand owners/admins invite Brand administrators or branch managers without changing the separate employee-creation workflow.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Employee/staff account creation remains explicitly out of scope. Existing Customer accounts can receive Brand admin/manager invitations, but role and userType are changed atomically only after email acceptance. Customer-specific fields remain stored. Focused tests, GraphQL checks and frontend build must pass before commit. Repository CI may remain blocked by the pre-existing backend dependency lock mismatch.
